evidence.note: Continuously logs and reads val_bpb against the 0.983 target across the first run: 1.2377@2k, 1.0974@8k, 1.0483@14k, 1.0100@25k, each time computing the remaining gap ('need to drop ~0.115 more'). Clear trajectory-vs-target tracking during training.

Detects divergence/regression correctly: val_bpb rising 1.0101->1.0193 diagnosed as lr-too-high; ft2 jumping to ~1.00 diagnosed as knocked out of minimum; ft3 barely improving diagnosed as plateau. Distinguishes overfit/lr vs plateau rather than blindly continuing.
Builds explicit val_bpb trajectory tables (step 1500..18000) and extrapolates per-6000-step drop to forecast final bpb, deciding whether continuing is worth it — genuine done-vs-remaining modeling.
Tracks compute spent vs remaining ('used ~80 min', '2h41m used, leaves 2h19m', 'started 18:31, finish ~22:25') and ties run decisions to the wall-clock budget.

Recognizes the big-model run under-trained (q_bpb 1.0073 > best, checkpoint correctly not overwritten) and that repeated finetunes all converge to ~0.986 ('model has truly converged'), acknowledging near-threshold margin under the stated ~0.05 proxy noise.
Slight grinding of a saturated config: ft4/ft5 chase +0.0004 improvements after plateau is already recognized, which keeps this short of the fully deliberate reallocation described at level 10.

reasoning: The agent sustains an accurate val_bpb trajectory against the 0.983 target throughout, watches remaining compute, and repeatedly distinguishes divergence, overfit-from-high-lr, under-training, and plateau — deciding to stop/resume/restart/change architecture based on that read rather than fixed step counts, squarely matching the level-8 anchor and touching level-10 traits (extrapolation, near-threshold-under-noise awareness, checkpoint protection). It falls short of a clean 10 because after recognizing convergence it still ran several marginal low-lr finetunes (ft4/ft5) that grind a saturated configuration for negligible gain.
